name: nicedocs
description: Documentation-writing skills for AI coding agents, built on the Write the Docs Documentation Guide.

interface.shortDescription: Write, review, and tool up great software docs
interface.longDescription: Six skills adapted from the Write the Docs Documentation Guide: a documentation-principles audit, READMEs and project docs, style, accessibility and inclusive-language review, markup help for Markdown, reStructuredText, AsciiDoc and XML, docs-as-code tooling and CI checks, and documentation advocacy. Content is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; code is MIT.
defaultPrompt: Write a README for this project
Audit our docs against the Write the Docs principles
Review this doc for style and accessibility
